acceptedAnswer.text: Caregiver living quarters are dedicated residential spaces designed within or alongside a primary residence to house a live-in nurse, family caregiver, or home aide. Depending on your home's layout, this space can be an interior suite conversion, a garage conversion, or a newly built room addition. These quarters typically feature a private bedroom, a dedicated bathroom, and sometimes a kitchenette or private entrance. Setting up designated quarters ensures your caregiver has privacy and adequate rest while remaining close enough to deliver immediate, around-the-clock support. During planning, you can decide whether a shared family kitchen works or if an independent kitchenette best supports daily routines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Caregiver living quarters are dedicated private spaces within or added to a home, such as an in-law suite or garage conversion, providing private living areas for a live-in aide.
